readerUiConversion.staticDefaultRule: When ReaderUiStore has no explicit typography or page-space preference, sharedReaderSurface uses the live Figma default Noto Serif SC / 18px / 1.96 line-height / 15.8px paragraph gap / 2em indent and the Figma 72px/32px page space. An explicit ReaderUiStore value remains a behavior-owned override.
readerUiConversion.traceability: The rendered PaperLayer and ReadingContent carry their exact Phone/Tablet Figma node IDs. This is trace metadata only; it does not make DOM attributes a visual authority.

splitPerformed.summary: The 3 shared old reading-page overlay implementations (ReaderDirectoryPanel/ReaderAppearancePanel/ReaderReplacePanel) were split into retained shared primitives (DirectoryPanel/AppearancePanel/ReplacePanel) + retired reading-page implementations (old 3 types now explicit-gap, 0 fixtures, NOT deleted). ReaderBase no longer consumes the 3 old reading-page overlays; 23/23 historical reading-page implementations are fully unreachable.
splitPerformed.sourceSideSplit: Reader-UI schema enum 177 (174 + 3 new shared-primitive types DirectoryPanel/AppearancePanel/ReplacePanel); 17 surviving route fixtures rebound to new types; 13 retired route fixtures 0 residue; old 3 types now explicit-gap mirroring ReaderTtsPanel/ReaderSettingsPanel.
splitPerformed.consumerSideSplit: HarmonyOS 3 native structs renamed DirectoryPanel/AppearancePanel/ReplacePanel + reading-page sheet shells retired (ReaderModulePanelShell/ReaderQuickPanelShell wrappers removed, close-Image retired, inert chrome removed); 4 shared @Builder primitives retained; dispatch + CoverageRegistry + tests synchronized.
